concept: Text that turns into a field where it stands: the text is a button with a pencil, and editing swaps it for the groove at the same height.

default_to_avoid.pattern: an editable that shows a separate edit button and opens the field in a dialog
default_to_avoid.kind: inline edit, editable text, click to edit
default_to_avoid.why_not: a separate dialog moves the reader away from what they were editing; Pane edits in place at the same height

derivation.consequence: movement distances are small (a 2px lift, an 8 to 16px rise) so the layout never appears to move
derivation.form: editing swaps the text for the groove at the same height and place, so the line does not move

derivation.consequence: keyboard reaches everything a pointer can, with a visible focus ring on any backdrop
derivation.form: Enter saves, Esc puts the words back and focus returns to the text, so the keyboard does everything a pointer can

derivation.consequence: long ease-out curves (420 to 640ms) for arriving and hovering, a shorter one (200ms) for pressing because a press is a reply; under reduced motion every duration is zero at the token level
derivation.form: the pencil fades in on hover and focus on the long ease instead of appearing at once

options: A text button with a pencil
variants.picked: A text button with a pencil
variants.reason: A edits where the text is (P4) and is all keyboard (P6). B adds a control per value. C makes every value look like a form.

root.why: the wrapper holds either the text or the field in the same place

text.why: the text is a button at least 44px tall whose padding hangs into the margin so the words stay aligned

placeholder.why: an empty value shows its placeholder in the secondary tone

pencil.why: the pencil says the text can be edited and shows on hover, on focus and always on touch

body.why: the body size edits ordinary text at body size in both modes

title.why: the title size edits a heading at the title size and weight in both modes

field.why: the field takes the full row so the groove matches the width the text had room for

@media forced-colors: active.why: in forced colours the system draws the edges and marks so every part stays findable

@media hover: none.why: on touch screens the pencil is always shown because there is no hover

hover.why: under the pointer the text takes the quiet surface to show it can be pressed

focus-visible.why: the focus ring and the pencil show when the text is reached by keyboard

disabled.why: disabled text keeps a plain cursor and no pencil so it reads as fixed

background-color.why: the hover surface fades in on the hover ease

opacity.why: the pencil fades in on the hover ease instead of popping
